name: Villablino (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of light green, white and light green with a white central stripe, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villablino (a cross and rivers on red and blue) surrounded by a ring of yellow daffodils.
history: The arms of Villablino were published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado on 3 June 1971; the flag, approved in 2014, has dimensions 2:3 and consists of three horizontal stripes, two light green at the edges of 30.41 % each and a white central stripe.

features.role: Villablino arms — cross and rivers on red and blue
